html:
Both division leaders in the East stumbled Friday, as the Rays fell to the Orioles while the Yankees and Red Sox also won to gain ground, and the Braves dropped a tight one to the Brewers while the Phillies and Marlins closed the gap. The night's most dramatic finish came in Philadelphia, where the Phillies edged the Cardinals in a game that produced a 5.00 WPA swing.

  • Orioles beat the Rays, and both the Yankees (over Toronto) and Red Sox (over San Francisco) won to trim Tampa Bay's AL East lead. (YANKEES) (SOX) (RAYS)
  • Phillies outlasted the Cardinals 7-6 in the day's most dramatic game, while the Marlins edged the Nationals to also gain on Atlanta in the NL East. (CARDINALS) (NATIONALS)
  • Brewers knocked off the NL East-leading Braves 2-1 behind a strong outing from Jacob Misiorowski [6 IP, 0 ER, 6 K | 1.75 ERA, PAR 63]. (MIL)
  • Alex Bregman [3-5, 2 HR | RC 69] powered the Cubs with two homers, but Chicago still fell to the Mariners in a wild game. (CHC)
  • White Sox stormed back from an 8% win probability to stun the Mets 6-4, dealing New York another blow in the NL wild card race. (SOX)
  • MacKenzie Gore [6 IP, 0 ER, 7 K | 4.46 ERA, PAR 29] tossed six shutout innings as the Rangers nipped the Angels 2-1, pulling within a game of Houston in the AL West. (TEX)
  • Yoshinobu Yamamoto [6.1 IP, 2 ER, 9 K | 2.61 ERA, PAR 49] struck out nine as the Dodgers held off the Pirates 5-4. (LAD)
  • Guardians routed the Rockies 9-1 and the Diamondbacks blanked the Reds 9-0 in the day's most lopsided results. (GUARDIANS) (REDS)

The AL East and AL Central leaders both lost ground on a bad day for division front-runners, as the Rays fell to the Blue Jays and the White Sox were shut out by the Braves while Cleveland, Kansas City, Detroit, and Minnesota all gained. The Cardinals authored the day's most dramatic finish, rallying from an 11% win probability to beat the Reds 10-9.

  • Zach Neto [5-6, 1 HR | RC 65] powered the Angels to an 18-3 rout of the Astros, cutting into Houston's AL West lead. (LAA)
  • Jacob deGrom [6 IP, 0 ER, 10 K | 3.78 ERA, PAR 36] dominated as the Rangers shut out the Nationals 2-0, also gaining a game on Houston. (TEX)
  • The Cardinals stunned the Reds 10-9 in the day's biggest comeback. (CARDINALS)
  • Shane Bieber [7 IP, 1 ER, 7 K | 4.57 ERA, PAR 7] led the Blue Jays past the Rays 5-1, trimming Tampa Bay's AL East cushion. (TOR)
  • Gerrit Cole [6 IP, 1 ER, 8 K | 3.12 ERA, PAR 29] and the Yankees beat the Orioles 6-1 to gain a game in the AL East. (NYY)
  • The Guardians topped the Giants 5-2 and the Royals beat the Athletics 6-2, both gaining on the White Sox. (GIANTS) (ATHLETICS) (SOX)
  • Grant Holmes [6 IP, 0 ER, 3 K | 3.65 ERA, PAR 24] and the Braves shut out the White Sox 2-0. (ATL)
  • Garrett Mitchell [3-4, 1 HR | RC 55] homered as the Brewers held off the Mariners 7-4. (MIL)

Both NL division leaders lost ground Tuesday as the Braves and Brewers watched their pursuers gain. Atlanta fell in Minnesota while Washington, New York, and Philadelphia all won to close the NL East gap, and in the Central, Cincinnati and Pittsburgh both gained on Milwaukee.

  • Cade Cavalli [6 IP, 0 ER, 11 K | 3.23 ERA, PAR 43] dominated as the Nationals shut out the Rangers 6-0, with Andrés Chaparro [3-4, 1 HR | RC 23] and José Tena [2-3, 1 BB, 1 HR | RC 28] homering in the win. (WSH)
  • The Diamondbacks edged the Red Sox 7-6 in the day's most dramatic game, a 4.80 WPA swing that cost Boston ground in the AL East. (SOX)
  • The Royals staged the day's biggest comeback, rallying from a 7% win probability to beat the Athletics 9-7 behind Vinnie Pasquantino [3-4, 1 BB, 1 HR | RC 37]. (KC)
  • Rafael Flores Jr. [2-2, 2 HR] homered twice as the Pirates beat the Tigers 4-3, gaining a game in the NL Central race. (PIT)
  • Aaron Nola [7 IP, 1 ER, 8 K | 5.12 ERA, PAR 15] tossed seven strong innings as the Phillies beat the Marlins 4-1 to gain in the NL East. (PHI)
  • José Urquidy [6 IP, 0 ER, 8 K | 5.06 ERA, PAR 4] shut out the Cubs across six innings in the White Sox's 3-0 crosstown win at Wrigley. (CWS)
  • The Mets beat the Padres 4-2, and the Twins knocked off the Braves 6-4, both trimming NL East and wild card gaps. (PADRES) (BRAVES)
  • The Yankees beat the Orioles 5-3, the Giants blanked the Guardians 1-0 behind Adrian Houser [5 IP, 0 ER, 3 K | 4.08 ERA, PAR 20], and the Dodgers held off the Rockies 6-4. (SF)

The Milwaukee Brewers delivered the day's defining statement, obliterating the Seattle Mariners 22-0 behind a nine-run eighth inning that further damaged Seattle's wild card hopes. Meanwhile, all four division leaders lost ground, with the Rays, White Sox, Astros, and Braves each surrendering games in their respective races.

  • Milwaukee erupted for 9 runs in the 8th inning en route to a 22-0 rout of Seattle, with Kyle Harrison [5 IP, 0 ER, 8 K | 2.84 ERA, PAR 32] dominating on the mound. (MIL)
  • Boston, Toronto, and the Yankees all won to gain ground on AL East-leading Tampa Bay, with Mickey Gasper [2-2, 2 BB, 1 HR | RC 14] posting the day's top LWTS in the Red Sox victory. (BOS)
  • Cleveland, Minnesota, and Kansas City all won to cut into the White Sox' AL Central lead; the Royals rallied from a 5% win probability to beat the Athletics 4-3. (SOX) (ATHLETICS)
  • Texas and the Angels both won to gain on AL West-leading Houston, with Cal Quantrill [7 IP, 0 ER, 5 K | 3.15 ERA, PAR 20] tossing 7 shutout innings and George Klassen [7 IP, 0 ER, 7 K | 3.82 ERA, PAR 4] striking out 7 over 7 scoreless. (TEX) (LAA)
  • Philadelphia beat Miami 6-4 to gain a game on NL East-leading Atlanta, which fell to Minnesota.
  • San Diego knocked off the Mets 5-2 behind Manny Machado [3-4, 1 BB, 1 HR | RC 58]'s three-hit day, while the Dodgers survived Colorado 7-6 in a game that saw Willi Castro [2-3, 2 BB, 1 HR | RC 55] homer. (SD) (COL)
  • St. Louis blanked Cincinnati 3-0 as Kyle Leahy [5 IP, 0 ER, 6 K | 3.24 ERA, PAR 35] delivered 5 scoreless, and Masyn Winn [3-4, 1 HR | RC 45] paced the Cardinals offense. (STL)
  • The Cubs edged the White Sox 4-3 in the day's most dramatic game by WP (SOX)

The AL Central race tightened dramatically as first-place Chicago White Sox lost ground to all four division rivals, with the Tigers, Royals, and Twins each gaining a full game. Meanwhile, the Reds and Cardinals split a doubleheader in Cincinnati, capped by a stunning Reds comeback from a 5% win probability.

  • The Reds rallied past the Cardinals 6-5 after dropping the opener 2-1, splitting a doubleheader that featured the day's biggest comeback. (CARDINALS)
  • Cristopher Sánchez [6 IP, 1 ER, 6 K | 2.51 ERA, PAR 61] led the Phillies past the Marlins 6-5, moving Philadelphia closer in the NL East chase. (PHI)
  • The Tigers beat the Pirates 8-5 behind Hao-Yu Lee [3-3, 2 BB | RC 27], while the Royals downed the Athletics 9-5 as Bobby Witt Jr. [3-4, 1 BB, 1 HR | RC 69] homered — both teams gaining a full game on Chicago in the AL Central. (DET) (KC)
  • The Twins beat the Braves 4-2, further eroding Atlanta's NL East cushion as the Mets also topped the Padres 2-1 behind Nolan McLean [6 IP, 1 ER, 3 K | 3.35 ERA, PAR 40]. (NYM)
  • Pete Crow-Armstrong [4-5, 1 BB, 2 HR | RC 100] powered the Cubs past the crosstown White Sox 7-5, with Shota Imanaga [6 IP, 3 ER, 10 K | 3.77 ERA, PAR 29] striking out 10. (CHC)
  • Shohei Ohtani [4-5, 2 HR] homered twice as the Dodgers routed the Rockies 11-5, with Blake Snell [6 IP, 1 ER, 5 K | 3.60 ERA, PAR 6] turning in six strong innings. (LAD)
  • The Rays edged the Orioles 7-6 behind Yandy Díaz [2-3, 2 BB, 1 HR | RC 82], extending Baltimore's slide in the AL East. (TB)
  • The Red Sox crushed the Diamondbacks 11-1 at Fenway. (DIAMONDBACKS) (SOX)

All three AL East and NL West division leaders lost ground Saturday, but the biggest shakeup came in the AL East, where both the Orioles and Yankees gained a full game on the Rays. Noah Cameron [9 IP, 0 ER, 8 K | 4.17 ERA, PAR 33] delivered the day's signature performance with a complete-game shutout in Kansas City's win at Anaheim.

  • Noah Cameron tossed a complete-game shutout as the Royals beat the Angels 3-0. (KC)
  • The Orioles routed the Rays 10-2 and the Yankees edged the Blue Jays 4-3, both cutting into Tampa Bay's AL East lead. (ORIOLES) (YANKEES)
  • The Phillies rallied from a 4% win probability to beat the Twins 7-5 in the day's biggest comeback. (PHILLIES)
  • The Rockies gained a game in the NL West with a 13-7 win over the Giants, while the Padres blanked the Guardians 5-0 to also close on the Dodgers, who fell 6-2 to the Brewers. (PADRES) (ROCKIES) (BREWERS)
  • The Mariners and Athletics both gained a game on the AL West-leading Astros, with Seattle winning 3-2 in Houston and the A's beating Texas 5-2. (ATHLETICS) (MARINERS)
  • Jordan Walker [3-4, 1 BB, 1 HR | RC 79] led the Cardinals to an 11-4 win over the Cubs, costing Chicago a game in the NL Central. (STL)
  • Other results: Braves 5, Diamondbacks 3; Mets 4, Nationals 3; White Sox 7, Tigers 5; Marlins 7, Reds 1; Pirates 8, Red Sox 3. (SOX) (PIRATES) (DIAMONDBACKS) (NATIONALS) (MARLINS)

All four division leaders lost ground on a chaotic Friday, with the Rays, Astros, Dodgers, and Braves each watching multiple challengers cut into their leads. The most dramatic swing came in St. Petersburg, where Baltimore edged Tampa Bay in a game with the day's largest WPA shift, while Joshua Báez [3-4, 3 HR | RC 9] stole the headlines at Wrigley with a three-homer explosion.

  • Orioles beat Rays 4-3 in the day's most dramatic game, as Baltimore, Boston, and Toronto all gained a game on the AL East-leading Rays. (ORIOLES)
  • Joshua Báez hit 3 home runs to power the Cardinals past the Cubs 8-4 at Wrigley Field. (STL)
  • Angels shut out the Royals 1-0 behind a dominant outing from Reid Detmers [8 IP, 0 ER, 11 K | 3.78 ERA, PAR 39], while Seattle routed Houston 10-5 and Texas rallied from a 14% win probability to beat the Athletics 5-3 — all three AL West chasers gained on the Astros. (LAA)
  • Diamondbacks crushed the Braves 10-3 behind a two-homer game from Nolan Arenado [2-4, 1 BB, 2 HR | RC 58], as Arizona, Philadelphia (9-1 over Minnesota), Miami (8-4 over Cincinnati), and the Mets (5-4 over Washington) all gained on NL East-leading Atlanta. (AZ)
  • Brewers beat the Dodgers 4-1 and the Giants throttled Colorado 7-1, with both Milwaukee's win and San Francisco's cutting into the NL West picture. (GIANTS) (BREWERS)
  • Red Sox blanked the Pirates 4-0 behind Sonny Gray [7 IP, 0 ER, 7 K | 2.66 ERA, PAR 43], and Jakob Marsee [4-4, 1 HR | RC 41] went 4-for-4 with a homer in Miami's win. (BOS) (MIA)
  • White Sox held off the Tigers 4-3, dropping Det (SOX) (DET)

The NL Central race tightened dramatically as all three chasers behind Milwaukee gained ground: the Brewers lost to the Dodgers while the Cubs, Reds, and Pirates all won, cutting into Milwaukee's lead. Chicago's Clay Holmes [6.2 IP, 0 ER, 3 K | 2.57 ERA, PAR 21] shut down St. Louis at Wrigley, and Cincinnati's Chase Burns [7 IP, 0 ER, 8 K | 2.47 ERA, PAR 46] delivered the day's top pitching performance in a 1-0 win over Miami.

  • Clay Holmes and the Cubs blanked the Cardinals 3-0, gaining a game on Milwaukee in the NL Central. (CHC)
  • Chase Burns tossed seven scoreless as the Reds edged the Marlins 1-0. (CIN)
  • The Pirates pounded the Red Sox 8-4 behind Rafael Flores Jr. [3-4, 1 HR], completing the Brewers' rough day in the standings. (PIT)
  • The Mets beat the Nationals 4-1, gaining a game in the NL East as Atlanta lost to Arizona 2-0 behind Brandon Pfaadt [7 IP, 0 ER, 7 K | 3.12 ERA, PAR 26]. (AZ)
  • The Orioles beat the Rays 6-5 and the Blue Jays topped the Yankees 3-1, with both clubs gaining a game on Tampa Bay in the AL East; Gunnar Henderson [4-4, 1 HR | RC 60] led Baltimore's attack. (BAL)
  • The Astros overcame a 10% win probability to stun the Mariners 10-7, the day's most dramatic swing. (MARINERS)
  • Miguel Vargas [4-5, 2 HR | RC 74] powered the White Sox past the Tigers 9-5, while the Royals edged the Angels 7-6 and the Athletics rolled over the Rangers 8-3 behind Jeff McNeil [4-5, 1 HR | RC 37]. (CWS) (ATH)
  • The Dodgers beat the Brewers 3-1, the Padres held off the Guardians 7-5, and the Rockies knocked off the Gi (PADRES) (BREWERS) (ROCKIES)

The Brewers pulled off the day's defining moment, rallying from a 4% win probability to beat the Dodgers 5-4 in the most dramatic game on the slate — a result that keeps Milwaukee two games ahead of the Dodgers and Braves among the sport's top records while maintaining a four-game NL Central lead over the Cubs. Meanwhile, Braxton Ashcraft [9 IP, 1 ER, 10 K | 3.89 ERA, PAR 35] authored the day's signature individual performance with a complete-game gem in Pittsburgh's rout of Miami.

  • Braxton Ashcraft threw a complete game as the Pirates crushed the Marlins 13-1, with Jared Triolo [3-4, 1 BB, 1 HR | RC 25] and Rafael Flores Jr. [2-5, 2 HR] each homering. (PIT)
  • The Brewers rallied from a 4% win probability to defeat the Dodgers 5-4, the day's biggest comeback and largest WPA swing. (BREWERS)
  • The Reds edged the White Sox 9-8 in a wild affair, with Sal Stewart [2-3, 2 BB, 1 HR | RC 74] and Tyler Stephenson [2-3, 2 BB, 1 HR | RC 41] both going deep. (CIN)
  • Cade Cavalli [8 IP, 0 ER, 10 K | 3.37 ERA, PAR 39] tossed eight shutout innings as the Nationals blanked the Cubs 7-0. (WSH)
  • Payton Tolle [8 IP, 0 ER, 4 K | 2.97 ERA, PAR 37] spun eight scoreless as the Red Sox shut out the Blue Jays 7-0. (BOS)
  • Logan Gilbert [6 IP, 0 ER, 7 K | 3.29 ERA, PAR 42] led the Mariners past the Yankees 1-0 in a taut pitchers' duel. (SEA)
  • Brandon Marsh [2-2, 2 BB, 1 HR | RC 61] homered in the Phillies' 7-1 win over the Twins at the Field of Dreams. (PHI)
  • The Tigers shut out the Guardians 3-0, and Walbert Ureña [6 IP, 0 ER, 5 K | 2.69 ERA, PAR 33] helped the Angels blank the Rangers 7-0. (LAA)

Alex Bregman [3-3, 2 BB, 3 HR | RC 67]'s three-homer explosion powered the Cubs to a 12-6 rout of the Nationals, trimming Chicago's deficit in the NL Central to 3.0 games as Milwaukee dropped a 4-3 decision to San Diego in the day's most dramatic game (5.37 WPA swing). The Cardinals also gained ground on the Brewers with a 7-1 win over Philadelphia.

  • Alex Bregman hit 3 home runs in the Cubs' 12-6 win at Washington, cutting Milwaukee's NL Central lead to 3.0 games. (CHC)
  • The Padres edged the Brewers 4-3 in a game featuring the day's largest WPA swing (5.37). (BREWERS)
  • The Cardinals cruised past the Phillies 7-1 behind a dominant outing, gaining ground in the NL Central while Philadelphia lost ground in the NL East. (PHILLIES)
  • Luis Castillo [7 IP, 0 ER, 10 K | 4.98 ERA, PAR 16] tossed 7 shutout innings with 10 strikeouts as the White Sox blanked the Reds 5-0. (CWS)
  • Trent Grisham [3-5, 2 HR | RC 46] homered twice as the Yankees rolled past the Mariners 10-5 at Yankee Stadium. (NYY)
  • The Rockies upset the Diamondbacks 6-4 in Arizona, costing the D-backs ground in the NL West while Colorado gained in the NL wild card race. (ROCKIES)
  • The Angels beat the Rangers 5-2, gaining a game in the AL wild card race behind Corey Seager [3-4, 1 HR | RC 27]'s 3-hit effort for Texas in the loss. (TEX)
  • The Twins, Guardians, and Blue Jays all won to gain ground in the AL wild card picture, defeating the Orioles, Tigers, and Red Sox respectively. (ORIOLES) (GUARDIANS) (SOX) (JAYS)

The NL Central race tightened dramatically as the leading Brewers lost 11-2 to San Diego while the Cubs, Cardinals, and Reds all won, with Chicago now just 4.0 games back. Meanwhile, Nick Martinez [9 IP, 4 ER, 5 K | 2.74 ERA, PAR 41] went the distance for Tampa Bay in a 12-4 rout of the Athletics.

  • Nick Martinez threw a complete game as the Rays blew out the Athletics 12-4. (TB)
  • The Cubs beat the Nationals 8-6 to pull within 4.0 games of Milwaukee in the NL Central. (CUBS)
  • The Padres crushed the Brewers 11-2, with Luis Campusano [3-4, 1 BB, 1 HR | RC 25] homering to lead the offense. (SD)
  • Eury Pérez [7 IP, 0 ER, 7 K | 3.41 ERA, PAR 32] tossed seven shutout innings as the Marlins blanked the Pirates 2-0. (MIA)
  • Blake Snell [6 IP, 1 ER, 10 K | 5.00 ERA, PAR 3] struck out 10 in the Dodgers' 5-4 win over the Royals, the day's most dramatic game by WPA swing. (LAD)
  • Cristopher Sánchez [6 IP, 0 ER, 7 K | 2.55 ERA, PAR 59] was brilliant in defeat as the Cardinals shut out the Phillies 2-0 behind him being outdueled. (PHI)
  • The Rockies edged the Diamondbacks 3-2, gaining ground in the NL wild card race while Arizona lost ground in the NL West. (ROCKIES)
  • Pete Alonso [3-4, 1 BB, 1 HR | RC 75] and Christian Encarnacion-Strand [3-4, 1 HR | RC 10] each homered as the Orioles beat the Twins 5-2. (BAL)

The New York Mets pulled within a game of momentum in the NL East race with an 8-5 win at Truist Park, joining Philadelphia, Washington, and Miami in chipping away at Atlanta's lead. Meanwhile, the Rays continued to look dominant, erupting for eight runs in the eighth inning to bury the Athletics 10-6.

  • Tampa Bay scored 8 runs in the 8th inning en route to a 10-6 win over the Athletics, with Yandy Díaz [3-4, 1 HR | RC 76] leading the charge. (TB)
  • Francisco Lindor [3-5, 1 HR | RC 35] homered as the Mets beat the Braves 8-5, cutting into Atlanta's NL East lead. (NYM)
  • The Phillies edged the Cardinals 6-5 to gain a game in the NL East, while dealing STL a blow in the NL wild card race. (PHILLIES)
  • Dean Kremer [7 IP, 1 ER, 7 K | 5.25 ERA, PAR 4] was dominant in Minnesota's 9-5 win over Baltimore, backed by a 4-for-5 day from Austin Martin [4-5, 1 HR | RC 33]. (MIN)
  • MacKenzie Gore [5.1 IP, 1 ER, 9 K | 4.43 ERA, PAR 28] struck out 9 as Texas beat the Angels 4-1, despite a homer from Mike Trout [1-2, 3 BB, 1 HR | RC 62]; the Rangers sit just 0.5 GB in the AL West. (TEX)
  • Cam Smith [3-4, 1 HR | RC 46] paced Houston to a 6-3 win over the Giants at Oracle Park, keeping the Astros atop the AL West. (HOU)
  • The Dodgers held off Kansas City 6-5, the Blue Jays edged Boston 2-1, and San Diego topped Milwaukee 3-2. (JAYS) (DODGERS)
  • Arizona blanked Colorado 9-0 at Chase Field.

Both NL West contenders gained a full game on the Dodgers, who lost at Arizona while San Diego handled Houston — tightening a division Los Angeles now leads by 7.5 over the Diamondbacks and 8.5 over the Padres. Philadelphia's one-run win over Toronto produced the day's biggest WPA swing at 5.64.

  • Kyle Schwarber [2-3, 3 BB, 2 HR | RC 82] and the Phillies edged the Blue Jays 7-6 in the day's most dramatic game, with Jesús Luzardo [7 IP, 2 ER, 12 K | 3.33 ERA, PAR 46] dominant on the mound. (PHI)
  • Arizona beat the Dodgers 4-2 and San Diego topped Houston 7-2, with both leaders — Los Angeles and Houston — losing ground. (DODGERS)
  • Pete Alonso [3-3, 2 BB, 2 HR | RC 72] powered Baltimore to a 10-5 win at Texas, gaining a game in the AL wild card race. (BAL)
  • Atlanta beat the Yankees 2-1 behind Cam Schlittler [7 IP, 1 ER, 11 K | 2.22 ERA, PAR 58]'s strong but losing effort; New York fell further back in the AL East. (NYY)
  • The Athletics stunned Boston 4-3 at Fenway, costing the Red Sox a game in the AL East. (ATHLETICS) (SOX)
  • The Mets routed Pittsburgh 11-1 as Sean Manaea [7 IP, 1 ER, 11 K | 4.15 ERA, PAR 21] dealt and Bo Bichette [5-5, 1 BB | RC 55] collected five hits. (NYM)
  • Milwaukee outlasted Minnesota 4-3, with Jake Bauers [2-3, 2 BB, 1 HR | RC 67] homering for the NL Central leaders. (MIL)
  • Detroit beat San Francisco 3-1 behind Logan Webb [8 IP, 1 ER, 2 K | 3.59 ERA, PAR 38]'s tough-luck start and Troy Melton [6 IP, 0 ER, 5 K | 1.46 ERA, PAR 31]'s scoreless outing, gaining a game in the AL wild card race. (SF)

Both NL East and AL West leaders lost ground Saturday, as Washington and Miami each pulled a game closer to Atlanta, while Texas closed to within a half-game of Houston in the AL West. The day's most dramatic finish came in Arizona, where the Dodgers edged the Diamondbacks 2-1 in a game with a 5.39 WPA swing to maintain their 8.5-game division lead.

  • The Dodgers beat the Diamondbacks 2-1 in the day's most dramatic game, dropping Arizona further back in the NL West. (DODGERS)
  • The Blue Jays outlasted the Phillies 7-5 in Philadelphia in another high-swing contest. (JAYS)
  • Sandy Alcantara [7 IP, 0 ER, 8 K | 3.53 ERA, PAR 42] dominated as the Marlins shut out the Angels 7-0, gaining ground on Atlanta in the NL East. (MIA)
  • The Nationals routed the Reds 8-2 behind a strong offensive showing, also gaining on the Braves. (BRAVES) (REDS)
  • The Rangers beat the Orioles 5-1 to pull within a half-game of Houston, who fell 3-2 to the Padres on Michael King [6 IP, 1 ER, 6 K | 3.37 ERA, PAR 34]'s strong start. (SD)
  • Jac Caglianone [4-4, 2 HR | RC 60] went 4-for-4 with 2 HR as the Royals downed the Cubs 6-3; Jake McCarthy [4-5, 2 HR | RC 64] also went 4-for-5 with 2 HR in Colorado's 8-6 win at St. Louis. (KC) (COL)
  • Gerrit Cole [7 IP, 2 ER, 9 K | 3.37 ERA, PAR 23] struck out 9 over 7 innings as the Yankees edged the Braves 5-4, with George Lombard Jr. [2-3, 1 BB, 1 HR | RC 6] homering. (NYY)
  • Bubba Chandler [6 IP, 0 ER, 5 K | 4.26 ERA, PAR 23] tossed 6 shutout innings as the Pirates blanked the Mets 9-0, gaining ground in the NL wild (PIT)
